info.title: LUNARA Fast Journal Desk
info.description: Private editorial desk for LUNARA Journal with consolidated operations and deterministic featured-image presence and quality diagnostics. Publishing is disabled by default and excluded from the standard ChatGPT editor scope. A separately publish-scoped credential may use the explicit single-entry action only when Control Plane publishing is enabled, validation passes, and Dalton explicitly instructs the GPT to publish. Never schedules, bulk publishes, deletes, trashes, changes post status outside the dedicated publish action, or activates configuration.

content.description: Approved replacement body as publishable WordPress HTML.

acf.description: Only allowlisted Journal ACF fields are accepted.

get.description: Opens the complete Journal Desk in one call: authenticated profile, bridge health, active Control Plane summary, Dispatch status, draft counts, featured-image diagnostics, actionable warnings, and recent drafts.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass the 60-second desk cache only when the user explicitly asks for a fresh refresh.

200.description: Journal Desk snapshot including image_counts and compact image diagnostics for each draft.

get.summary: Open one complete Journal editing workspace
get.description: Returns the selected draft, full featured-image diagnostics (attachment, MIME, URL, dimensions, aspect ratio, alt text, errors and warnings), required ACF/source/provenance fields, current deterministic validation, and active compact editorial configuration.

200.description: Complete editing workspace including full featured-image diagnostics.

post.summary: Save the approved revision and validate it in one request
post.description: Use only after Dalton approves the exact proposed revision. Saves allowlisted draft fields, records attribution, preserves draft status, and runs deterministic validation including the featured-image hard gate and quality warnings.

200.description: Saved draft plus validation result and featured-image diagnostics.

post.description: Queues the feed/AI/image run asynchronously inside WordPress and returns immediately. It does not wait for generation to finish and cannot publish anything.

post.summary: Mark a validated draft ready for Dalton
post.description: Runs validation again, including the featured-image hard gate, sets the internal ready-for-editor state only when validation passes, and preserves WordPress draft status. Never publishes.

get.summary: Retrieve the audit trail only when requested
get.description: Use only for an explicit provenance or troubleshooting request. The normal workspace intentionally omits full audit history for speed.

post.summary: Publish a single validated Journal draft immediately
post.description: Publishes exactly one validated Journal entry when Control Plane publishing is enabled and Dalton explicitly instructs the GPT to publish now. The request must confirm immediate publication. Scheduling, bulk publishing, and silent publication are refused.

confirm_publish_now.description: Must be true only after Dalton explicitly instructs the GPT to publish this exact entry now.

200.description: The Journal entry was published successfully.

403.description: The credential lacks publish scope or GPT publishing is disabled in the active Control Plane configuration.

409.description: The Journal entry failed validation and cannot be published.
